format.description: Language-neutral golden cases of the assistant protocol (models.md 3.7). Every implementation loads protocol.json, then for each case checks that its output equals `expected` exactly.
format.render: render_messages(protocol, lang, app_name, sections, question) -> (system, user). `expected.question` is the normalised question (also the value that is substituted into `user`). Compare strings code point for code point.
format.parse: parse_answer(protocol, lang, output, k) -> outcome in refused|answered|invalid, and `cited` (the cited positions; empty unless answered).
format.select: select_sections(protocol, ranked, max_sections) -> ids of the selected sections in order. `max_sections` null means the protocol value; a value can only lower it.
format.lengths: All lengths (question cut, body characters, section characters) are counted in Unicode code points. Implementations whose strings are UTF-16 (TypeScript, C#) must count code points, not code units; case r12-astral-cut checks it.
format.whitespace: Whitespace for trimming and collapsing is exactly this set: U+0009 to U+000D, U+0020, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000 to U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000, U+FEFF.
format.normalisation: Unicode NFC, then CRLF to LF, for the question, the application name and every section title and text. Question: then trim, collapse whitespace runs to one space, cut at context.max_question_chars. Parsing: CRLF to LF and trailing whitespace trimmed before any test.
format.substitution: One left-to-right pass over a template; only the placeholders of models.md 3.2 are replaced; substituted values are never scanned again.
